publicTests.name: Reset and ready state
publicTests.objective: Confirm reset restores an idle UART and readable ready status.
publicTests.scenario: Apply reset, then nonintrusively observe STATUS, tx and busy.

publicTests.name: Firmware transmits ASCII A
publicTests.objective: Trace the C driver polling STATUS and writing TXDATA through the real bridge.
publicTests.scenario: Call firmware_send with one byte 0x41 and a sufficient poll limit.
publicTests.expected: A TXDATA write occurs, busy asserts, an 8N1 frame for 0x41 appears, then STATUS.TX_READY returns to 1.

publicTests.name: Zero polling budget
publicTests.objective: Verify firmware obeys its timeout contract.
publicTests.expected: Firmware returns -1 without completing a frame.

publicTests.name: Write while busy is ignored
publicTests.objective: Verify the RTL does not start a second frame from a busy-state write.
publicTests.scenario: Start 0x55 then issue a second TXDATA write while busy.
publicTests.expected: Only the first frame is transmitted and the UART later returns ready.

publicTests.name: Multi-byte frame sequence
publicTests.objective: Verify consecutive UART frames from one firmware call.
publicTests.scenario: Transmit 0x00, 0x55 and 0xff with a sufficient polling budget.
publicTests.expected: Three valid 8N1 frames appear in order, each decoded from the actual TX signal.

publicTests.name: Reset during transmission
publicTests.objective: Verify reset immediately returns the UART to a defined idle state.
publicTests.scenario: Start transmitting 0xa5, assert rst_n low during the frame, then release reset.
publicTests.expected: busy clears, TX returns high, STATUS.TX_READY becomes 1 and the interrupted frame is not treated as a completed valid frame.
